import os
import sys
import json
import base64
import argparse
import mimetypes
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

import requests
from openai import OpenAI


DEFAULT_BASE_URL = ""
DEFAULT_MODEL = "anthropic/claude-mythos-5"
MAX_TOKENS = 128000
DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE = 0.7
DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = "You are a helpful assistant."


class RequestyClientError(Exception):
    pass


def get_api_key(explicit_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    api_key = explicit_key or os.environ.get("REQUESTY_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise RequestyClientError(
            "Missing API key. Set the REQUESTY_API_KEY environment variable or pass --api-key."
        )
    return api_key


def build_client(api_key: str, base_url: str) -> OpenAI:
    return OpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)


def encode_pdf_to_data_url(path: Union[str, Path]) -> str:
    file_path = Path(path)
    if not file_path.exists():
        raise RequestyClientError(f"PDF file not found: {file_path}")
    if not file_path.is_file():
        raise RequestyClientError(f"Path is not a file: {file_path}")
    raw_bytes = file_path.read_bytes()
    encoded = base64.b64encode(raw_bytes).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:application/pdf;base64,{encoded}"


def is_remote_pdf(reference: str) -> bool:
    return reference.startswith("http://") or reference.startswith("https://")


def build_pdf_file_data(reference: str) -> str:
    if is_remote_pdf(reference):
        return reference
    return encode_pdf_to_data_url(reference)


def build_pdf_filename(reference: str) -> str:
    if is_remote_pdf(reference):
        name = reference.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
        if name:
            return name
        return "document.pdf"
    return Path(reference).name


def build_text_message(role: str, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"role": role, "content": text}


def build_pdf_message(prompt: str, pdf_reference: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {
                "type": "text",
                "text": prompt,
            },
            {
                "type": "input_file",
                "filename": build_pdf_filename(pdf_reference),
                "file_data": build_pdf_file_data(pdf_reference),
            },
        ],
    }


def build_web_search_tools() -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    return [{"type": "web_search"}]


def extract_message_content(message: Any) -> str:
    content = getattr(message, "content", None)
    if content is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts: List[str] = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                text_value = item.get("text")
                if isinstance(text_value, str):
                    parts.append(text_value)
            else:
                text_attr = getattr(item, "text", None)
                if isinstance(text_attr, str):
                    parts.append(text_attr)
        return "".join(parts)
    return str(content)


def print_usage(usage: Any) -> None:
    if usage is None:
        return
    prompt_tokens = getattr(usage, "prompt_tokens", None)
    completion_tokens = getattr(usage, "completion_tokens", None)
    total_tokens = getattr(usage, "total_tokens", None)
    cost = getattr(usage, "cost", None)
    sys.stderr.write("\n--- Usage ---\n")
    if prompt_tokens is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"prompt_tokens: {prompt_tokens}\n")
    if completion_tokens is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"completion_tokens: {completion_tokens}\n")
    if total_tokens is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"total_tokens: {total_tokens}\n")
    if cost is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"cost: {cost}\n")
    sys.stderr.flush()


def run_completion(
    client: OpenAI,
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    model: str,
    max_tokens: int,
    temperature: float,
    tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]],
    stream: bool,
    top_p: Optional[float],
) -> str:
    request_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": messages,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "temperature": temperature,
    }
    if top_p is not None:
        request_kwargs["top_p"] = top_p
    if tools:
        request_kwargs["tools"] = tools

    if stream:
        request_kwargs["stream"] = True
        request_kwargs["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
        collected: List[str] = []
        final_usage: Any = None
        response_stream = client.chat.completions.create(**request_kwargs)
        for chunk in response_stream:
            chunk_usage = getattr(chunk, "usage", None)
            if chunk_usage is not None:
                final_usage = chunk_usage
            choices = getattr(chunk, "choices", None)
            if not choices:
                continue
            delta = getattr(choices[0], "delta", None)
            if delta is None:
                continue
            delta_content = getattr(delta, "content", None)
            if isinstance(delta_content, str) and delta_content:
                collected.append(delta_content)
                sys.stdout.write(delta_content)
                sys.stdout.flush()
        sys.stdout.write("\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        print_usage(final_usage)
        return "".join(collected)

    response = client.chat.completions.create(**request_kwargs)
    if not response.choices:
        raise RequestyClientError("The API returned no choices.")
    text = extract_message_content(response.choices[0].message)
    sys.stdout.write(text)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    print_usage(getattr(response, "usage", None))
    return text


def command_chat(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if args.system:
        messages.append(build_text_message("system", args.system))
    if args.prompt:
        prompt_text = args.prompt
    elif not sys.stdin.isatty():
        prompt_text = sys.stdin.read()
    else:
        raise RequestyClientError("No prompt provided. Pass --prompt or pipe text via stdin.")
    messages.append(build_text_message("user", prompt_text))
    tools = build_web_search_tools() if args.web_search else None
    run_completion(
        client=client,
        messages=messages,
        model=args.model,
        max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
        temperature=args.temperature,
        tools=tools,
        stream=args.stream,
        top_p=args.top_p,
    )
    return 0


def command_pdf(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if args.system:
        messages.append(build_text_message("system", args.system))
    messages.append(build_pdf_message(args.prompt, args.file))
    tools = build_web_search_tools() if args.web_search else None
    run_completion(
        client=client,
        messages=messages,
        model=args.model,
        max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
        temperature=args.temperature,
        tools=tools,
        stream=args.stream,
        top_p=args.top_p,
    )
    return 0


def command_search(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if args.system:
        messages.append(build_text_message("system", args.system))
    messages.append(build_text_message("user", args.query))
    run_completion(
        client=client,
        messages=messages,
        model=args.model,
        max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
        temperature=args.temperature,
        tools=build_web_search_tools(),
        stream=args.stream,
        top_p=args.top_p,
    )
    return 0


def command_interactive(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    system_prompt = args.system or DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
    messages.append(build_text_message("system", system_prompt))
    tools = build_web_search_tools() if args.web_search else None
    sys.stdout.write("Interactive mode. Type 'exit' or 'quit' to leave.\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    while True:
        try:
            user_input = input("You: ")
        except EOFError:
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
            break
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
            break
        stripped = user_input.strip()
        if stripped.lower() in {"exit", "quit"}:
            break
        if not stripped:
            continue
        messages.append(build_text_message("user", user_input))
        sys.stdout.write("Assistant: ")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        assistant_text = run_completion(
            client=client,
            messages=messages,
            model=args.model,
            max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
            temperature=args.temperature,
            tools=tools,
            stream=args.stream,
            top_p=args.top_p,
        )
        messages.append(build_text_message("assistant", assistant_text))
    return 0


def add_common_arguments(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument("--api-key", default=None, help="Requesty API key. Defaults to REQUESTY_API_KEY.")
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", default=DEFAULT_BASE_URL, help="Requesty router base URL.")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default=DEFAULT_MODEL, help="Model identifier.")
    parser.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=MAX_TOKENS, help="Maximum number of tokens to generate.")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE, help="Sampling temperature.")
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=None, help="Nucleus sampling probability.")
    parser.add_argument("--system", default=None, help="Optional system prompt.")
    parser.add_argument("--stream", action="store_true", help="Enable streaming responses.")
    parser.add_argument("--web-search", action="store_true", help="Enable the web_search tool.")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="main.py",
        description="Requesty router client for Claude Mythos 5 with chat, PDF, and web search support.",
    )
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    chat_parser = subparsers.add_parser("chat", help="Send a chat completion request.")
    add_common_arguments(chat_parser)
    chat_parser.add_argument("--prompt", default=None, help="User prompt text. Reads stdin if omitted.")
    chat_parser.set_defaults(func=command_chat)

    pdf_parser = subparsers.add_parser("pdf", help="Send a PDF for analysis (base64 file or URL).")
    add_common_arguments(pdf_parser)
    pdf_parser.add_argument("--file", required=True, help="Local PDF path or remote PDF URL.")
    pdf_parser.add_argument("--prompt", default="Summarize this PDF", help="Instruction for the PDF.")
    pdf_parser.set_defaults(func=command_pdf)

    search_parser = subparsers.add_parser("search", help="Run a query with web search enabled.")
    add_common_arguments(search_parser)
    search_parser.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="Search query for the model.")
    search_parser.set_defaults(func=command_search)

    interactive_parser = subparsers.add_parser("interactive", help="Start an interactive chat session.")
    add_common_arguments(interactive_parser)
    interactive_parser.set_defaults(func=command_interactive)

    return parser


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        return args.func(args)
    except RequestyClientError as error:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {error}\n")
        sys.stderr.flush()
        return 1
    except requests.RequestException as error:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Network error: {error}\n")
        sys.stderr.flush()
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

2. `DEFAULT_MODEL = "anthropic/claude-mythos-5"` may fail if the provider does not recognize that exact model string, because the code hardcodes a specific model identifier without validation or fallback.[4][1]

3. `build_web_search_tools()` returns `[{"type": "web_search"}]`, but Requesty’s docs for Claude web search indicate `web_search_preview` for Claude models, while `web_search` is described for Gemini/Google grounding, so this tool choice is likely incompatible with the default Claude model.[5][6][4]

7. `command_pdf()` labels the feature as “PDF analysis” but does not check whether the selected model supports PDF vision/file inputs, so the program can accept an apparently valid command and then fail at the API.[7][2]

8. `encode_pdf_to_data_url()` reads the entire PDF into memory and base64-encodes it, which can become very expensive or fail for large PDFs because the code imposes no size guard or streaming strategy.[9][2]

9. `build_pdf_filename()` derives a filename from a remote URL by taking the last path segment, which can produce misleading names such as queryless fragments or non-PDF names if the URL is not cleanly formed.[9]

10. `build_pdf_file_data()` returns remote URLs unchanged, but `build_pdf_message()` always uses the `filename` field without adding `file_url`, so the structure does not fully express the URL-based PDF path that some APIs expect.[2][9]

11. `extract_message_content()` concatenates all text fragments without separators, which can merge distinct blocks of model output and destroy formatting when content arrives as a list of parts.[10]

12. `extract_message_content()` ignores non-text content parts, so any assistant response that includes structured content, annotations, or tool-related items may be silently truncated.[10]

13. `run_completion()` assumes the first choice is always the one to print, which is usually fine for single-choice requests but still silently discards any additional choices returned by the API.[10]

14. `run_completion()` uses `stream_options={"include_usage": True}` for streamed requests, which is correct for OpenAI-style chat streaming, but that usage chunk is not guaranteed to be returned by every compatible proxy or provider implementation.[3][11][10]

15. `run_completion()` prints streamed content only from `delta.content`, so any streamed tool call deltas, structured segments, or non-text events are ignored.[3][10]

16. `run_completion()` does not handle tool calls as a conversation loop, so if the model returns a tool request rather than a final answer, the script does not execute or append any tool result and therefore cannot complete an actual tool-using interaction.[12][5][4]

17. `command_interactive()` appends every assistant reply back into `messages`, but because tool calls are not handled, an interactive session with a tool-enabled model can enter a dead-end where the conversation history accumulates incomplete assistant turns.[12][4]

18. `command_interactive()` always seeds the conversation with `DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT` unless `--system` is provided, which may be surprising for users who expect a blank system context in interactive mode.  

19. `get_api_key()` only reads `REQUESTY_API_KEY`, but the docs emphasize Requesty’s API key usage and do not mention other environment names in this script, so portability is limited to that exact variable.[13][1]

20. `build_client()` passes only `api_key` and `base_url`, ignoring optional headers like `HTTP-Referer` and `X-Title` that Requesty recommends for analytics tagging.[13]

21. `command_chat()` prefers `--prompt` over stdin, which is sensible, but it does not trim or validate empty strings passed via `--prompt`, so an accidental empty prompt can be sent to the API.  

22. `command_pdf()` requires `--file` but does not validate that the file is actually a PDF before uploading it, so a non-PDF path can be sent and fail downstream.[2][9]

23. `is_remote_pdf()` classifies any HTTP or HTTPS reference as a remote PDF, even if the URL points to HTML, a redirect, or a non-PDF asset.  

24. `build_pdf_filename()` does not preserve a `.pdf` extension when the remote URL lacks one, which can reduce clarity and may affect provider-side file handling heuristics.[9]

25. `run_completion()` raises `RequestyClientError("The API returned no choices.")` if the API returns an empty choice list, but it does not include context such as model or request type, which makes debugging harder.  

26. `main()` catches `requests.RequestException` but not `openai`-specific exceptions, JSON encoding issues, or argparse-level edge cases beyond parse-time behavior, so several API-client failures can escape the script’s intended error handling.  

27. `command_search()` duplicates the web-search-enabled completion flow instead of reusing `command_chat()`, which increases maintenance burden and the chance of drift between code paths.  

28. `command_chat()` and `command_search()` both construct nearly identical request flows, but only one accepts `--query` and the other `--prompt`, which is a small but avoidable API inconsistency.  

29. `DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE = 0.7` is hardcoded even though some provider/model combinations perform better or only reliably support different defaults, so the script may introduce unwanted nondeterminism.  

30. `MAX_TOKENS = 128000` is set universally, but some models and providers reject that maximum or cap completion length differently, so this default can exceed actual provider limits.[1][4]

31. `run_completion()` does not surface response metadata besides usage, so important provider warnings or finish reasons are lost to the caller.[3][10]

32. `print_usage()` writes usage information to stderr after the assistant output, which is fine for logs but can confuse consumers who expect the program to emit only model text.  

33. `extract_message_content()` returns `str(content)` for unsupported content types, which can leak Python object representations into output rather than a clean, user-facing message.  

34. The code imports `json` and `mimetypes` but never uses them, which is harmless but dead code and a maintenance smell.  

35. The code imports `Optional` and `Union` appropriately, but `Dict[str, Any]` request payloads are manually assembled throughout, increasing the risk of shape mismatches that static typing cannot catch.  

36. `build_text_message()` makes no attempt to normalize whitespace or reject empty messages, so the message history can contain blank turns.  

37. `command_interactive()` stores the assistant text exactly as returned, but if streaming output already printed line by line and the model later adds hidden formatting, the stored transcript may not match the user-visible stream exactly.  

38. `build_parser()` makes `dest="command"` required, which is correct for a CLI, but the script offers no top-level help text for choosing among modes beyond subparser help.  

39. `run_completion()` assumes `client.chat.completions.create()` accepts `tools` for every model used here, but tool availability varies by endpoint and model family, so this can produce provider-specific runtime errors.[4][6][12]

40. The script’s Requesty/OpenAI compatibility is not internally consistent: it mixes chat-completions semantics, file-input semantics, and generic `web_search` tooling without selecting the exact variant required by the model family, so the most likely runtime failures are capability mismatches rather than syntax errors.[5][1][4][2]

```python
import os
import sys
import json
import base64
import argparse
import mimetypes
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

import requests
from openai import OpenAI


DEFAULT_BASE_URL = ""
DEFAULT_MODEL = "anthropic/claude-mythos-5"
MAX_TOKENS = 128000
DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE = 0.7
DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = "You are a helpful assistant."


class RequestyClientError(Exception):
    pass


def get_api_key(explicit_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    api_key = explicit_key or os.environ.get("REQUESTY_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise RequestyClientError(
            "Missing API key. Set the REQUESTY_API_KEY environment variable or pass --api-key."
        )
    return api_key


def build_client(api_key: str, base_url: str) -> OpenAI:
    return OpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)


def encode_pdf_to_data_url(path: Union[str, Path]) -> str:
    file_path = Path(path)
    if not file_path.exists():
        raise RequestyClientError(f"PDF file not found: {file_path}")
    if not file_path.is_file():
        raise RequestyClientError(f"Path is not a file: {file_path}")
    raw_bytes = file_path.read_bytes()
    encoded = base64.b64encode(raw_bytes).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:application/pdf;base64,{encoded}"


def is_remote_pdf(reference: str) -> bool:
    return reference.startswith("http://") or reference.startswith("https://")


def build_pdf_file_data(reference: str) -> str:
    if is_remote_pdf(reference):
        return reference
    return encode_pdf_to_data_url(reference)


def build_pdf_filename(reference: str) -> str:
    if is_remote_pdf(reference):
        name = reference.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
        if name:
            return name if name.lower().endswith(".pdf") else f"{name}.pdf"
        return "document.pdf"
    name = Path(reference).name
    if not name:
        return "document.pdf"
    return name if name.lower().endswith(".pdf") else f"{name}.pdf"


def build_text_message(role: str, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"role": role, "content": text}


def build_pdf_message(prompt: str, pdf_reference: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {
                "type": "text",
                "text": prompt,
            },
            {
                "type": "input_file",
                "filename": build_pdf_filename(pdf_reference),
                "file_data": build_pdf_file_data(pdf_reference),
            },
        ],
    }


def build_web_search_tools(model: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if model.startswith("anthropic/"):
        return [{"type": "web_search_preview"}]
    return [{"type": "web_search"}]


def extract_message_content(message: Any) -> str:
    content = getattr(message, "content", None)
    if content is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts: List[str] = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                text_value = item.get("text")
                if isinstance(text_value, str):
                    parts.append(text_value)
            else:
                text_attr = getattr(item, "text", None)
                if isinstance(text_attr, str):
                    parts.append(text_attr)
        return "\n".join(parts)
    return str(content)


def print_usage(usage: Any) -> None:
    if usage is None:
        return
    prompt_tokens = getattr(usage, "prompt_tokens", None)
    completion_tokens = getattr(usage, "completion_tokens", None)
    total_tokens = getattr(usage, "total_tokens", None)
    cost = getattr(usage, "cost", None)
    sys.stderr.write("\n--- Usage ---\n")
    if prompt_tokens is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"prompt_tokens: {prompt_tokens}\n")
    if completion_tokens is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"completion_tokens: {completion_tokens}\n")
    if total_tokens is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"total_tokens: {total_tokens}\n")
    if cost is not None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"cost: {cost}\n")
    sys.stderr.flush()


def run_completion(
    client: OpenAI,
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    model: str,
    max_tokens: int,
    temperature: float,
    tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]],
    stream: bool,
    top_p: Optional[float],
) -> str:
    request_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": messages,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "temperature": temperature,
    }
    if top_p is not None:
        request_kwargs["top_p"] = top_p
    if tools:
        request_kwargs["tools"] = tools

    if stream:
        request_kwargs["stream"] = True
        request_kwargs["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
        collected: List[str] = []
        final_usage: Any = None
        response_stream = client.chat.completions.create(**request_kwargs)
        for chunk in response_stream:
            chunk_usage = getattr(chunk, "usage", None)
            if chunk_usage is not None:
                final_usage = chunk_usage
            choices = getattr(chunk, "choices", None)
            if not choices:
                continue
            delta = getattr(choices[0], "delta", None)
            if delta is None:
                continue
            delta_content = getattr(delta, "content", None)
            if isinstance(delta_content, str) and delta_content:
                collected.append(delta_content)
                sys.stdout.write(delta_content)
                sys.stdout.flush()
        sys.stdout.write("\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        print_usage(final_usage)
        return "".join(collected)

    response = client.chat.completions.create(**request_kwargs)
    if not response.choices:
        raise RequestyClientError("The API returned no choices.")
    text = extract_message_content(response.choices[0].message)
    sys.stdout.write(text)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    print_usage(getattr(response, "usage", None))
    return text


def command_chat(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if args.system:
        messages.append(build_text_message("system", args.system))
    if args.prompt:
        prompt_text = args.prompt
    elif not sys.stdin.isatty():
        prompt_text = sys.stdin.read()
    else:
        raise RequestyClientError("No prompt provided. Pass --prompt or pipe text via stdin.")
    messages.append(build_text_message("user", prompt_text))
    tools = build_web_search_tools(args.model) if args.web_search else None
    run_completion(
        client=client,
        messages=messages,
        model=args.model,
        max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
        temperature=args.temperature,
        tools=tools,
        stream=args.stream,
        top_p=args.top_p,
    )
    return 0


def command_pdf(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if args.system:
        messages.append(build_text_message("system", args.system))
    messages.append(build_pdf_message(args.prompt, args.file))
    tools = build_web_search_tools(args.model) if args.web_search else None
    run_completion(
        client=client,
        messages=messages,
        model=args.model,
        max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
        temperature=args.temperature,
        tools=tools,
        stream=args.stream,
        top_p=args.top_p,
    )
    return 0


def command_search(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if args.system:
        messages.append(build_text_message("system", args.system))
    messages.append(build_text_message("user", args.query))
    run_completion(
        client=client,
        messages=messages,
        model=args.model,
        max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
        temperature=args.temperature,
        tools=build_web_search_tools(args.model),
        stream=args.stream,
        top_p=args.top_p,
    )
    return 0


def command_interactive(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    api_key = get_api_key(args.api_key)
    client = build_client(api_key, args.base_url)
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    system_prompt = args.system or DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
    messages.append(build_text_message("system", system_prompt))
    tools = build_web_search_tools(args.model) if args.web_search else None
    sys.stdout.write("Interactive mode. Type 'exit' or 'quit' to leave.\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    while True:
        try:
            user_input = input("You: ")
        except EOFError:
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
            break
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
            break
        stripped = user_input.strip()
        if stripped.lower() in {"exit", "quit"}:
            break
        if not stripped:
            continue
        messages.append(build_text_message("user", user_input))
        sys.stdout.write("Assistant: ")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        assistant_text = run_completion(
            client=client,
            messages=messages,
            model=args.model,
            max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
            temperature=args.temperature,
            tools=tools,
            stream=args.stream,
            top_p=args.top_p,
        )
        messages.append(build_text_message("assistant", assistant_text))
    return 0


def add_common_arguments(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument("--api-key", default=None, help="Requesty API key. Defaults to REQUESTY_API_KEY.")
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", default=DEFAULT_BASE_URL, help="Requesty router base URL.")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default=DEFAULT_MODEL, help="Model identifier.")
    parser.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=MAX_TOKENS, help="Maximum number of tokens to generate.")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE, help="Sampling temperature.")
    parser.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=None, help="Nucleus sampling probability.")
    parser.add_argument("--system", default=None, help="Optional system prompt.")
    parser.add_argument("--stream", action="store_true", help="Enable streaming responses.")
    parser.add_argument("--web-search", action="store_true", help="Enable the web_search tool.")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="main.py",
        description="Requesty router client for Claude Mythos 5 with chat, PDF, and web search support.",
    )
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    chat_parser = subparsers.add_parser("chat", help="Send a chat completion request.")
    add_common_arguments(chat_parser)
    chat_parser.add_argument("--prompt", default=None, help="User prompt text. Reads stdin if omitted.")
    chat_parser.set_defaults(func=command_chat)

    pdf_parser = subparsers.add_parser("pdf", help="Send a PDF for analysis (base64 file or URL).")
    add_common_arguments(pdf_parser)
    pdf_parser.add_argument("--file", required=True, help="Local PDF path or remote PDF URL.")
    pdf_parser.add_argument("--prompt", default="Summarize this PDF", help="Instruction for the PDF.")
    pdf_parser.set_defaults(func=command_pdf)

    search_parser = subparsers.add_parser("search", help="Run a query with web search enabled.")
    add_common_arguments(search_parser)
    search_parser.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="Search query for the model.")
    search_parser.set_defaults(func=command_search)

    interactive_parser = subparsers.add_parser("interactive", help="Start an interactive chat session.")
    add_common_arguments(interactive_parser)
    interactive_parser.set_defaults(func=command_interactive)

    return parser


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        return args.func(args)
    except RequestyClientError as error:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {error}\n")
        sys.stderr.flush()
        return 1
    except requests.RequestException as error:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Network error: {error}\n")
        sys.stderr.flush()
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
